our_interpretation: The checkable core is that both OpenAI and Anthropic burn billions of dollars. 'Information war' is a metaphor for the competing financial leaks he describes. I treat it as framing and do not score it on its own.

'Burn billions' (plain reading): each company used up at least about $1 billion of cash, net, on the yearly scale people usually mean by that phrase. He named no period. I use the latest full year before the post (2025) plus the latest quarter reported before the post (Q1 2026).
Net loss is not cash burn. Large non-cash fair-value charges in either company's net loss do not count as burn.
The hedged IPO aside ('allegedly ... as soon as today') is not scored.
criteria.support_condition: Credible reports or filings show each company had a net cash outflow of about $1 billion or more within 2025 to Q1 2026.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Either company is shown to have had no net cash outflow of about $1 billion or more within 2025 to Q1 2026, for example by being cash-flow positive across that span.
